title: Papyrus Lint CLI report
description: The JSON document emitted by PapyrusLinterCLI --json.

files.description: Every resolved Papyrus script, including scripts with no diagnostics.

scripts_checked.description: The number of resolved Papyrus scripts checked by this run.

files_with_diagnostics.description: The number of checked scripts that produced at least one diagnostic.

total_diagnostics.description: The total number of diagnostics across all files.

files_fixed.description: The number of scripts changed by automatic fixes, or null when the fix subcommand was not used.

success.description: Whether the lint result exits successfully under the configured failure thresholds.

path.description: The resolved script path as displayed by the CLI.

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics reported for this script, or an empty array when it is clean.

line.description: The 1-indexed source line where the diagnostic starts.

column.description: The 1-indexed source column where the diagnostic starts.

rule.description: The stable, hyphenated identifier of the lint rule.

level.description: The diagnostic severity, or null for an unclassified external diagnostic.

message.description: The human-readable diagnostic message, including its severity prefix when classified.
